name: pyrefly-lsp
description: Python LSP on pyrefly: complete find-references and outgoing calls, sync with disk, git worktrees without their own .venv. Install the pyrefly binary separately: uv tool install pyrefly.

type_checking_mode.title: Type-checking mode without a pyrefly config
type_checking_mode.description: For files not covered by pyrefly.toml or [tool.pyrefly]: auto migrates mypy/pyright settings, otherwise uses the basic preset; default, strict and all are stricter; off reports no errors. The project config always wins.

diagnostics.title: Type errors after edits
diagnostics.description: Pass pyrefly errors to Claude after each edit. Turn off if a linter hook already reports them: navigation keeps working.

sync_from_disk.title: Sync with disk
sync_from_disk.description: Tell the server about files changed outside Claude (git, a formatter, another agent). Turn off only for troubleshooting.

complete_outgoing_calls.title: Complete outgoing calls
complete_outgoing_calls.description: Add the calls pyrefly loses inside await and expressions (facebook/pyrefly#5486). Turn off only for troubleshooting.

pyrefly_path.title: Path to pyrefly
pyrefly_path.description: Optional. By default: the project's .venv (for a git worktree, the main checkout's), then PATH.

indexing_limit.title: Indexing limit
indexing_limit.description: How many project files pyrefly indexes for find-references. 0 keeps its default (2000). Higher gives more complete search on large projects but uses more memory.
